centres.lead: The pharmacies, imaging centres and labs the clinic works with — outside, or inside the clinic. Send them the prescription or the lab / imaging request from its page; surgery dates go to hospitals from the Surgeries page.

kind_sub.imaging: Imaging requests are sent to them.
kind_sub.lab: Lab requests are sent to them.
kind_sub.hospital: Surgery dates are sent to them from the Surgeries page.

centres.name: Name
centres.in_house_list: Requests arrive on its list in DocBook
centres.in_house_q: Inside the clinic (e.g. an imaging centre or pharmacy in the same building)
centres.in_house_help: No message is sent: the request appears on its list in DocBook, and the staff record the result or the hand-over.
centres.add_sub: Add a WhatsApp number or an e-mail address, or choose “inside the clinic”.
centres.delete_confirm: Delete {name}? What was sent to it stays in the log.

err.WRONG_PARTNER: This partner does not take this paper.
err.NO_EMAIL: This partner has no e-mail address.
err.NO_MAIL: E-mail is not set up for the clinic.
err.MAIL_FAILED: The e-mail could not be sent.
err.NO_PHONE: This partner has no valid WhatsApp number.

queue_lead.pharmacy: Prescriptions sent to this pharmacy inside the clinic.
queue_lead.imaging: Imaging requests sent to this centre — open a request to record the result and attach the images.
queue_lead.lab: Lab requests sent to this lab — open a request to record the result.
